description: This file defines the SiloHealthMonitor class which is responsible for monitoring the health of remote silos in the Orleans cluster. It includes methods for starting/stopping the monitor, probing silos directly and indirectly, and handling probe results. It also contains internal structures for probe results and various logging methods.

classes.name: SiloHealthMonitor
classes.description: Manages health checks on a specific remote silo, performs regular probing via direct or indirect methods, and maintains probe results and health status.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes and begins the health monitoring process for the silo.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the health monitoring, waiting for ongoing probes to complete.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing monitoring and disposes resources.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes resources after stopping the monitor.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main loop executing periodic probes of the target silo.

methods.name: ProbeDirectly
methods.description: Sends a direct ping probe to the target silo and processes the response.

methods.name: ProbeIndirectly
methods.description: Probes the target silo via an intermediary silo, handling response and health evaluation.

methods.name: CheckHealth
methods.description: Returns the current health status of the monitor based on recent probes.
